# Vendored Powerline symbols font

RF Swift Workbench bundles the Powerline symbols font so that shell prompts
using Powerline separators (the agnoster theme of the RF Swift images, for
example) draw their arrows in the embedded terminals, whatever fonts the
host has. `app.css` limits it to these characters with `unicode-range`:
U+E0A0-E0A2 and U+E0B0-E0B3.

- Version: powerline `2.8.4`, commit `51570938d4a558578fa3512a4b546584530e23c1`
- Upstream: <https://github.com/powerline/powerline> (`font/PowerlineSymbols.otf`)
- File SHA-256: `4a2496a009b1649878ce067a7ec2aed9f79656c90136971e1dba00766515f7a1`
